title: Robinhood brings crypto trading to UK in AI-powered all-in-one app
summary: The trading firm is also introducing “Robinhood Cortex Digests for Crypto,” a generative AI-powered widget that analyses breaking news and other data.

title: Live updates: BTC above $65,000 even as the Senate punts the CLARITY Act to the fall
summary: The market rose even as the Senate left the crypto bill unpassed before its recess, with steady ETF inflows and a softer dollar doing more for prices than Washington.

title: This bitcoin miner rejected BIP-110 despite mining through a pool that supported it
summary: Ocean, a bitcoin mining pool, had been backing BIP-110 by default. Simple Mining, a company that runs mining machines through Ocean, used software from the pool that lets individual miners choose for themselves and went the other way.

title: Bitcoin tops $65,000 with US inflation data due this week
summary: Every major except XRP is green on the week, with BTC, ether and BNB each up nearly 3% as global stocks trade near a record.

title: XRP is getting left behind in the crypto bounce even as ETFs keep attracting investor money
summary: The token fell 5% last week while BTC, ETH and SOL climbed.
